item.text: The lock rule is now a pure function over the stored subscription, with inclusive time comparisons for trial and cancellation dates. Next I’m adding the shared service guard and wiring the read-only summary fields, then applying the guard across the mutation services.

I’m using a small scripted edit to insert `await assertWorkspaceWritable(orgId)` immediately after each write permission check. That preserves the existing refusal order and avoids changing background jobs or notification housekeeping.

item.text: The service guards are in place, including invitation acceptance after token validity checks but before membership creation. I found one edge case in that flow and corrected it so even an already-existing membership cannot cause an otherwise locked invitation acceptance path to bypass the lock.

I’m doing a final source consistency pass now. One visible UI hole is that the shell’s “New project” affordance remains enabled during a lock even though the service refuses it, so I’m making the banner state disable that entry point too.
